projects.scope: Implement kl_lock_allowed(context,kind,rt) for conservative teaching policy: context0 task,1 hardirq,2 softirq; kind0 mutex,1 spinlock_t,2 raw_spinlock_t. projects.scope: Implement kl_work for serialized state {queued,running,closed,released}. Events0 submit,1 begin,2 complete,3 close,4 release. Admission fails when closed or occupied; begin transfers queued to running; complete requires running; close is idempotent; release succeeds only once when closed and neither queued nor running. Rejected events preserve state.
